title: The Midnight Veil
author: Kestrel Kavanagh
blurb: Wren Okonkwo, the youngest member of a dying guild, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
